## Feature PR Template

### 📝 Description
Brief description of the changes and the problem this solves.

Closes #issue_number

### 🔧 Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Refactoring (no functional changes, improves code structure)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement

### ✨ What's Changed
- Change 1: Description
- Change 2: Description  
- Change 3: Description

### 🧪 Testing
- [ ] Unit tests pass (`sbt test`)
- [ ] Integration tests pass (`sbt it:test`)
- [ ] Manual testing completed
- [ ] Test coverage maintained/improved

**Testing Details:**
Describe specific testing performed, edge cases covered, etc.

### 📚 Documentation
- [ ] Code is self-documenting with clear variable names
- [ ] Complex logic has comments explaining the "why"
- [ ] Public APIs have scaladoc/docstrings
- [ ] README updated (if applicable)
- [ ] Migration guide created (if breaking changes)

### 🔍 Code Quality
- [ ] Code follows project style guide (`sbt scalafmtCheck`)
- [ ] No new compiler warnings
- [ ] No new security vulnerabilities
- [ ] Performance impact assessed

### 🚀 Deployment Considerations
- [ ] No database migrations required
- [ ] No configuration changes required
- [ ] Backward compatible
- [ ] Can be deployed independently

**Deployment Notes:**
Any special considerations for deployment.

### 📋 Checklist
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published

### 📸 Screenshots/Demos
If applicable, add screenshots or demos showing the changes.

### 🤔 Questions for Reviewers
Any specific areas you'd like reviewers to focus on or questions you have.

### 🔗 Related Issues/PRs
List any related issues, PRs, or discussions.

---
**Review Focus Areas:**
- [ ] Logic correctness
- [ ] Performance implications  
- [ ] Security considerations
- [ ] Error handling
- [ ] Testing completeness
